axes: scoring feature and ranking distance normalization

training.source: frozen wide-control causal rollouts on fit64 only
training.label: current known point agrees with at least 80% pure past known emitted identity; unknown-only histories masked
training.features: old/new edge evidence, three-observation prefix and relative competitor evidence; no IDs, absolute timestamps or truth
training.threshold: fit-validation group-winner precision >= .97, maximize recall; conservative counterpart targets .99

existing_id_memory_ablation.guard: affinity >= .90 before trusted-memory update for emitted IDs with >=4 trusted entries
existing_id_memory_ablation.purpose: separate mid-track memory contamination from first-output continuation

followup_score_correction.reason: high-precision stand-alone head has low fit-validation recall and first full calibration regresses to fragmentation 65.84
followup_score_correction.selection: fit-validation16 only; maximize correct - 5*wrong, no lower precision or utility than frozen proxy; keep candidate geometry and distance penalty
followup_score_correction.conditional_memory_combination: only if both fusion seeds pass original overall guards and reduce identity cost
